name: com.agtnames/agt
title: AGT agent names
description: Resolve, verify and discover .agt agent names: owner, records, signed manifest, endpoints.

environmentVariables.name: AGT_CHAIN
environmentVariables.description: Chain to read: polygon (mainnet, needs nothing else), amoy or localhost.

environmentVariables.name: AGT_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the JSON-RPC endpoint for the selected chain.

environmentVariables.name: AGT_REGISTRY
environmentVariables.description: Override the registry contract address (required only for localhost or a custom deployment).

environmentVariables.name: AGT_IPFS_GATEWAY
environmentVariables.description: Pin ipfs:// manifest reads to one allow-listed gateway; unset walks pinata, dweb.link, ipfs.io, w3s.link, cloudflare-ipfs in order.

environmentVariables.name: AGT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout for RPC and IPFS calls, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: AGT_RATE_PER_MIN
environmentVariables.description: Tool calls per minute before the server answers rate_limited.

environmentVariables.name: AGT_SESSION_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional, 12+ characters. Enables the countersign write tools (agt_session_*, agt_set_*); the local session key is stored encrypted under AGT_SESSION_DIR.

environmentVariables.name: AGT_SESSION_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the encrypted session key and imported grant.
